text.description_html:
AHI SD-SIG405-400-630 15-3/4 Inch Stainless Ladder Shower Handles

15-3/4" ladder style shower handles made of stainless steel by AHI Hardware. Warm Satin Stainless Steel finish requiring little maintenance, designed to enhance any setting where a clean contemporary look is desired.

These contemporary ladder style handles feature a nice sized 1-1/4" round grip handle that is very comfortable. Packaged with glass shower door mounting kit.

Specifications for AHI SD-SIG405-400-630 Ladder Style Shower Handles

  • Total Height: 400 mm (15-3/4")
  • Mounting Centers: 150 mm (5-15/16") C/C
  • Projection: 80 mm (3-1/8")
  • Handle Diameter: 32 mm (1-1/4") Round
  • Material: 304 Stainless Steel Tubing
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel

Packaged with 2 door handles and includes all the hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors with a 1/2" diameter hole.

*Sold as a Pair (2 Pull Handles)



**Item Discontinued use 16" Glass Door Pulls or 14" Glass Door Pulls
